title: A House for the Choir
author: Orsen Reyes
blurb: Petra Coldharbour, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, has spent seven years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must finish the ritual the founders started before the well refills.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
